questions.prompt: Who was the first European known to reach India by sea around Africa?
questions.fact: The voyage took him longer to cross the Indian Ocean than the entire Atlantic leg, because he had to wait on the monsoon.

questions.prompt: Which body part contains the smallest bones in the human body?
questions.fact: The smallest is about the size of a grain of rice, and all three reach full adult size before birth.

questions.prompt: Which trophy is awarded to the winner of the men's football World Cup?
questions.fact: The original trophy was won outright by Brazil in 1970, then stolen in 1983 and never recovered.

questions.prompt: Which superhero team includes Cyclops, Storm and Wolverine?
questions.fact: The 1975 relaunch that made them famous deliberately assembled an international line-up to sell the comic overseas.

questions.prompt: Which ocean lies between Africa and Australia?
questions.fact: It is the warmest ocean, which limits how much oxygen its water can hold and shapes what lives in it.

questions.prompt: Which novel opens with a family fleeing the Oklahoma Dust Bowl?
questions.fact: Its author spent months living in migrant camps before writing a word of it.

questions.prompt: What is a cookie in a web browser?
options: A small data file stored by a site
questions.fact: The name comes from magic cookie, an older programming term for a token passed back and forth unchanged.
